scene: Steam shoots skyward, parting the clouds and revealing three bustling travel docks.
picture: Flat side view. Along a sky platform, on the far left, an emerald dragon maglev train sits idle. On the left, the vented clay jar releases cyan steam. Left of centre, the player stands on roller skates. In the centre, a sleek bullet train waits. On the far right, a solar-sail junk floats moored.
shown: a winding emerald maglev train shaped like a dragon waits on the left
a sleek pink-striped bullet train sits ready at the centre platform
a wooden junk with glowing solar sails is docked on the far right
